marketing.faq-1-answer: One year from the confirmation of the payment, on 1 computer, with no automatic renewal. After that, you buy the access again to keep getting updates and new apps, and the new term starts when the current one ends. What is already installed keeps working. To update, your token must be valid: every update renews it, and after 30 days without updating you revalidate it in the dashboard.
marketing.faq-2-question: What is the difference between access and the membership?
marketing.faq-2-answer: Access delivers the apps and their updates. The membership adds the depth layer: advanced guides, recipes, live sessions, a vote on what joins the store and up to 3 computers.
marketing.faq-3-question: Do I pay for AI credits?
marketing.faq-3-answer: No. The apps run in the AI you already use (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor), on your own plan or API. flyee.club never spends AI credits on your side.
marketing.faq-4-answer: Yes, in one click from the dashboard. The apps you installed keep working. Without access, updates stop at the end of the paid period; with access, they continue.

marketing.how-meta-title: How it works: installing and updating Claude Code skills
marketing.how-meta-description: One command connects your computer, another installs an app, and the same installer updates it. See the 30-day token, the checksum and the limits of version 1.
marketing.how-title: One command installs. The same installer updates.
marketing.how-subtitle: Everything arrives through the terminal, in the AI you already use. Every package comes with a version, a checksum and declared permissions, and your AI runs the apps on your own plan.
marketing.how-highlight-plan: Runs on your own AI plan

marketing.how-terminal-available: Available in this project's Claude Code and Codex
marketing.how-steps-title: Four steps, from the account to the first run
marketing.how-step-1-title: Create an account and pick your access
marketing.how-step-1-body: Access is a one-time payment, valid for 1 year, that unlocks every app in the store, with updates. The membership and Pro add depth.
marketing.how-step-2-body: The command opens the browser for you to approve the connection. On a machine without a browser, you type a short code in the dashboard.
marketing.how-step-3-body: The app joins the harness and works in the project's Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor.
marketing.how-step-4-body: The update fetches new versions, checks each package's checksum and shows the changelog.
marketing.how-rows-title: What happens when you install and update
marketing.how-rows-subtitle: The token, the package check and your own AI hold the rest together.
marketing.how-token-body: Every connected computer gets a token, and every update renews it for 30 days. After 30 days without updating, the next update asks you to revalidate in the dashboard. The harness warns you from day 25.
marketing.how-token-bullet-1: Installed apps keep working in the meantime
marketing.how-token-bullet-2: Each plan has a limit of computers connected at the same time
marketing.how-token-bullet-3: You disconnect a computer in the dashboard or with npx flyee logout
marketing.how-token-terminal-label: A terminal asking to revalidate the token after 30 days without updating
marketing.how-token-terminal-expired: It has been 31 days since this computer's last update.
marketing.how-token-terminal-revalidate: Revalidate at flyee.club/revalidar and run the update again.
marketing.how-security-title: Every package is checked before it installs
marketing.how-security-body: The installer downloads the package from our server, checks its sha256 checksum and shows the permissions the app declared, with the reason for each one. The same information is on a public verification page.
marketing.how-security-bullet-1: A published version never changes: a fix ships as a new version
marketing.how-security-bullet-2: A broken version is withdrawn, with the reason published
marketing.how-security-bullet-3: Nothing leaves your machine without notice
marketing.how-security-terminal-label: A terminal checking the checksum of a downloaded package
marketing.how-ai-title: Your AI is what runs the apps
marketing.how-ai-body: The harness is an agent file that points to the installed apps. Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or Cursor runs them, on your own subscription or API key.
marketing.how-ai-bullet-1: flyee never runs AI for you or spends your credits
marketing.how-ai-bullet-2: flyee only receives usage events: installs, runs and updates
marketing.how-ai-bullet-3: Never the content: no code, no prompts, no files
marketing.how-ai-media-caption: On your own plan or API key
marketing.how-band-title: Versions, checksums and declared permissions. You check before you install.
marketing.how-limits-title: What the first version does not do yet
marketing.how-limits-subtitle: Better to know before you buy.
marketing.how-limit-1-body: It works in Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI and Cursor. The Claude and ChatGPT chat apps come in a later version.
marketing.how-limit-2-body: The installer runs with npx, which ships with Node.js. Installing and updating need an internet connection and a valid token.
marketing.how-limit-3-title: Keys for other services are yours
marketing.how-limit-3-body: Some apps use outside services and say on their page which keys they need. Those accounts are yours, like your AI account.
marketing.how-faq-1-question: Do I need to know how to code?
marketing.how-faq-1-answer: Not to use the apps. Each one has a guide on using it, with no code. The advanced guides, which show how to adapt and extend them, come with the membership.
marketing.how-faq-2-question: On how many computers can I use it?
marketing.how-faq-2-answer: It depends on the plan: each one has a limit of computers connected at the same time, shown on the pricing page. You disconnect a computer in the dashboard and connect another.
marketing.how-faq-3-question: What happens after 30 days without updating?
marketing.how-faq-3-answer: Installed apps keep working. The next update asks you to revalidate your access in the dashboard; once you approve, it carries on.
marketing.how-faq-4-question: How do I check a package before installing it?
marketing.how-faq-4-answer: Every version has a public verification page with its sha256 checksum, size, supported AIs and declared permissions. The installer checks the same checksum when it downloads.
